title: VR-Sets-ZFA: A Lean 4 Formalisation of Operational Reference Semantics for Non-Well-Founded Sets
description:
Lean 4 formalisation of VR-Sets-ZFA, a foundational extension of VR-Sets (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20354340) providing operational reference semantics for non-well-founded sets with Aczel's Anti-Foundation Axiom (AFA) proved as a theorem.

The formalisation builds CoPSet — a coinductive parallel of mathlib's PSet — via PFunctor.M, constructs the quotient OSetZFA = Quotient CoPSet.cobisim, and proves AFA (AFA_in_OSetZFA) as the universal property of the final coalgebra. Well-founded sets (OSet = ZFSet) embed faithfully into OSetZFA via embedOSet. The Quine atom (quineAtom ∈ quineAtom) and omega chain are machine-verified non-vacuity witnesses. AFA uniqueness (bisimulation collapse: two-cycle ≡ self-loop) is demonstrated.

Technical facts:

  • 70 public objects across 8 files, 2109 lines of Lean
  • 8 axiom-free objects (pure structural/corecursive definitions)
  • 62 objects at [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] — mathlib's standard ceiling
  • No sorry, no admit, no axioms beyond mathlib ceiling
  • Lean 4.29.1 + mathlib4 v4.29.1; git tag v1.5-vr-sets-zfa

Main theorems: AFA_in_OSetZFA, quineAtom_self_mem, embedOSet_injective, embedOSet_mem, OSetZFA_mem_not_wf, quineAtom_not_in_range_embedOSet, cycleDecoration_eq_quineAtom.

Formally resolves Conjecture_IV_2_Statement from VR-Sets Conjectures.lean. Sixth work in the VR Lean cycle. Developed using Claude Opus 4.7 (architectural review) and Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Lean implementation), Variant A.
